statement: A uniformly conditioned rank-two cross block cannot be extended from a quadratically null opposite product bank by treating a small nonzero opposite self-block as a norm perturbation when the first bank has unrestricted self-curvature. For every 0<epsilon<1, independent cap-one uniforms give R=2 epsilon^-2 U1U2+2(U1V2+U2V1)+2 epsilon^2 V1V2=2(U1/epsilon+epsilon V1)(U2/epsilon+epsilon V2), with cross s2=1 and opposite self-block operator norm epsilon^2, but the output density diverges logarithmically at zero.
not_refuted: The full QFORM conjecture is not refuted: this four-variable matrix has only two nonzero eigenvalues, plus or minus (epsilon^-2+epsilon^2).
positive_replacement: Spend nonzero opposite-side curvature structurally through an original-coordinate square/pair/half-Riesz step or prove a genuinely two-sided product-weighted estimate; do not discard it by operator-norm smallness alone.
